page.content:
Late-1990s tone shift around Austin, DX, and Monday nights.

How Attitude Era connects

  • Character: Stone Cold Steve Austin — Stone Cold's antihero act defined the Attitude Era.
  • Topic: WWE — The Attitude Era is the late-1990s chapter of WWE television.
  • Character: Vince McMahon — Vince McMahon booked the Attitude Era that saved the ratings war.
  • Faction: D-Generation X — D-Generation X was an Attitude Era engine.
  • Event: Monday Night Wars — Losing early Monday Night Wars nights pushed WWE into the Attitude Era.

What is Attitude Era?

The Attitude Era is the 1997–2001 booking period when WWE chased older demos with Stone Cold, The Rock, D-Generation X, and a Vince McMahon heel-boss act.

Key threads lead to Stone Cold Steve Austin, WWE, Vince McMahon, D-Generation X and Monday Night Wars.
